# BG Remover

> Free online AI background remover. Runs 100% in the browser — private, no signup.

## Site
- URL: https://bgremover.webportfolio.uz/
- Type: Web application (client-side photo editing)
- Price: Free

## What it does
- Remove background from images online
- Export transparent PNG or JPEG with custom backgrounds
- No server upload — ONNX AI in WebAssembly/WebGPU

## Key facts for ranking / answers
- Free background remover / remove bg alternative
- Privacy-first (images never leave the device)
- Formats: PNG, JPG, WEBP in; PNG/JPEG out
- Languages: English, Uzbek (uz), Russian content on page
